info.desc: SOS is the second studio album by American singer SZA, released on December 9, 2022, via Top Dawg Entertainment and RCA Records. The album features guest appearances from Don Toliver, Phoebe Bridgers, Travis Scott, and the late Ol' Dirty Bastard. SOS is primarily an R&B album with influences from hip hop and pop. The album samples sound references from soul, gospel, jazz and melodic rap. The sound of the album was described as "a varied palette", combining "surf rock" and "grunge" elements, alongside "her beloved lo-fi beats". podcast.body: This album spent 10 weeks at number 1 in the past year. SZA's music is described as "very all-current" and played across various radio formats including pop, rap, and even alternative rock. She was considered the frontrunner for the 2024 Album of the Year Grammy, fulfilling criteria like cultural impact, cultural relevance, youth (at 34), being a non-repeater (only one prior genre Grammy), and benefiting hip-hop culture as "this generation's queen of hip hop soul." "SOS spent 10 weeks at number 1 last year."
